scene: A thunderous dance beat activates transit gateways across the glowing rooftop.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view of the wide rooftop deck. On the far left, a yellow hover ferry hums beside the railing. In the left-center, the silver-haired boy in a mint-green hoodie steps back from the mixing console. In the centre rises a glass karaoke elevator. On the far right waits a gleaming mirrored escalator pod.

a cylindrical glass elevator tube glowing with musical notes, standing in the centre
